关于阅览室的故事(A Story about the reading room): 一篇关于校园生活的A2短文:艾米与凯特的经历和小计划。
The weather was windy that day. Amy thinks history is interesting but a little difficult. Amy usually has bread for breakfast. Chalk games fill the schoolyard at break.
Amy borrowed a book about history from the zoo. Both of them like bread and tea. Life is full of small surprises. In fact, the crop is dependent on spring rain.

The reading room is one of the best places in the city. Amy wrote about the day in the diary. Amy and Kate had great fun there. Best of all, the guide explained the religious iconography of the old paintings.
Amy hopes to visit Chengdu one day. They took many photos at the teachers' office. Amy plays badminton with Kate every Wednesday.
